page: Amazon Web Services r9gd.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by an AWS Graviton processor. It features 1 dedicated physical core and 1 vCPU using the arm64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio designed for memory-intensive workloads at a smaller scale.

This instance includes 59 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, providing low-latency local block storage directly attached to the host. It operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, which offloads virtualization functions to dedicated hardware. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The r9gd.medium offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio and local NVMe storage, which is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring fast local scratch space and moderate memory footprints without the overhead of larger multi-core instances. However, the single-core configuration limits parallel processing capabilities, and baseline network throughput is constrained to 1 Gbps. This profile is suitable for small-scale databases, caching layers, and lightweight memory-intensive applications.
